comment: MiniWind test area (v0.0.57, POLYCOUNT-CAMPS-ALDRUHN-57): Urshilaku Camp, the single cell (-4, 18), the hottest cell of the CHIM polycount heatmap (63,288 faces placed in v0.0.56; its yurts carry about half). Checks the simplified yurts in game against the original: the same pose, faces drawn and frame time at 32 MB Fast. Centre = the middle of the cell; bounds +-1024 = the one cell. Not shipped (no shipped_since): built only by its MiniWind preset. No interiors: their doors show as unavailable.
